game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 3 examination practice: Algorithm synthesis: subtract 15 from each value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 3, operand 15.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about program_ok to power up the caravan guide and open the sundial.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
